component.name: RealityScan GTK
component.summary: Native front-end for RealityScan photogrammetry under Wine

description.p: A GTK4/libadwaita user interface for Epic's RealityScan. RealityScan itself runs headless under Wine and does all the processing; this application drives it through its Remote Command plugin: adding images, alignment, reconstruction, texturing, control points and scaling, masks, mesh clean-up (including a lasso) and export, with a native 3D viewport.
Requires RealityScan 2.2 installed either through Heroic Games Launcher (Proton) or from Epic's Linux package, and an NVIDIA GPU.
